title: Lazy Girl Pho (Rotisserie Chicken Pho)
summary: A cheat-code chicken pho built on a store-bought rotisserie chicken: the picked-over bones simmer with charred onion, ginger, a bag of pho spices and a jarred chicken pho soup base, fish sauce and seasonings, then the broth is ladled over fresh rice noodles and the reserved shredded chicken with a full topping bar. The creator gives the ingredient list in a comment reply; the only quantity stated anywhere is 10–12 cups of water.

ingredients.item: Rotisserie chicken bones (carcass after the meat is pulled off)
ingredients.note: One store-bought rotisserie chicken is picked apart on camera at 0:08–0:12; the meat is reserved for the bowls and the bones go into the broth. Her comment says "rotisserie chicken bones".
The only quantity she states anywhere: "10 to 12 cups of water" in her ingredient-list comment reply.
Halved on the cutting board at 0:14; a charred onion is handled with tongs over the pan at 0:18. Count unstated.
Sliced at 0:14, added to the pot at 0:30. Whether it is charred like the onion is not clearly shown.
Squeezed straight from the bottle into the pot at 0:46–0:47; the label reads Three Crabs Brand Fish Sauce (Nước Mắm Nhỉ).

Jar shown at 0:48–0:49: "Cốt Phở Gà — Chicken Flavored 'Phở' Soup Base", NET WT 10 OZ (283 g). A thick light-brown paste spooned/poured into the broth at 0:49–0:50. The maker's name on the jar was not legible.
Named in her comment list; no distinct addition is identifiable in the frames.

Packet held up at 0:20 reads Richin "SPICE SEASONING / Gia Vị Nấu Phở Bắc" (Northern-style pho spices), ingredients aniseed, cinnamon, coriander seeds, fennel, cloves; NET WT 1.5 OZ (43 g). The packet is labeled for beef pho (越南牛肉粉配料) but she uses it for this chicken version. Spices are spooned into a white spice bag at 0:24 and the tied bag simmers in the broth (visible at 0:33–0:35).

steps.text: Pull the meat off a store-bought rotisserie chicken and set the shredded meat aside in a bowl; keep the bones/carcass for the broth.
Halve the onion and slice the ginger.
In a pan on the stove, work with the onion and ginger in some liquid; a charred onion is lifted with tongs at 0:18 (the charring step itself is not shown).
Show the pho spice packet, then spoon its whole spices (anise, cinnamon, coriander, fennel, cloves) into a white spice bag and tie it.
Put the chicken bones, onion and ginger into a large pot.
Pour in the water (she states 10–12 cups in her comment).
Add the tied spice bag and bring the broth to a simmer; skim/stir as it cooks.
Lift the solids out with a mesh strainer, letting the broth drain back into the pot; the reserved shredded chicken sits in a separate bowl.
Pour the pan's remaining liquid/drippings into the pot.
Squeeze fish sauce into the broth.
Spoon/pour in the chicken pho soup base paste from the jar.
Stir the broth with a ladle. Her comment also lists MSG, chicken bullion and rock sugar for the broth; their exact addition moments are not identifiable on camera.

ingredients.note: VIDEO-ONLY: absent from her comment ingredient list. Package shown at 0:54–0:55 reads Sincere Orient Food Co. (新聯食品公司) "BÁNH PHỞ TƯƠI / Fresh Rice Noodle".

steps.text: Drop a nest of the fresh rice noodles into a separate pot of boiling water.
Lift the cooked noodles out with chopsticks/tongs and transfer them to serving bowls.

ingredients.item: Shredded rotisserie chicken (reserved from the broth prep)

ingredients.note: Her comment says "basil"; variety (Thai vs sweet) unstated.
A jar labeled "Ground Chili Garlic Sauce" is visible at the assembly; whether that is the chili oil she means is not confirmed.
Huy Fong bottle (green nozzle) visible; squeezed over the bowl at 0:65.
Dark sauce drizzled over the chicken at 0:66.

steps.text: Assemble the bowls: noodles topped with the shredded chicken, sliced onion, cilantro, basil and jalapeño.
Ladle the hot broth through a mesh strainer into each bowl.
Finish with sriracha and hoisin; serve with lime, bean sprouts and chili oil on the side.
Toss the noodles through the broth and eat.

notes: The written spec is her reply to @youngdaggerbree's ingredient request in the comments (screenshot supplied by Axel): "rotisserie chicken bones, 10 to 12 cups of water, onion, ginger, fish sauce, chicken pho soup base, MSG, chicken bullion, rock sugar & a bag of pho spices!! Limes, cilantro, chicken, basil, jalapeños, onions, bean sprouts, chili oil, sriracha & hoisin sauce for toppings!" Her spelling "bullion" is preserved.

The reel has no narration — local ASR over the full audio returned only the background song — and no on-screen ingredient/quantity cards (77-frame OCR sweep: only the "Lazy girl pho" watermark and product packaging). Steps and product identities come from control-proven vision reads of the frames.
Noodles are video-only: the fresh pho noodles are shown, cooked and plated but never named in her comment list. Recorded as a discrepancy, not silently merged into her written spec.
The Richin spice packet is labeled for Northern-style BEEF pho (Gia Vị Nấu Phở Bắc / 越南牛肉粉配料); she uses it in this chicken pho. Her comment just says "a bag of pho spices".
The soup-base jar reads "Cốt Phở Gà — Chicken Flavored 'Phở' Soup Base", 10 oz (283 g); the maker's name was not legible in any frame.
Fish sauce bottle reads Three Crabs Brand (Nước Mắm Nhỉ); sriracha is Huy Fong. Brands are what the frames show, not stated preferences.

Caption: "I tried making some cheat code pho AND BABYYYY!! This was a 10/10 😩 So easy to make & so flavorful!! 😋" — her own verdict, not an audited claim. No funnel/CTA surface in the caption or the captured comment thread.
